title: Jonathan Blow Reveals Details on 'Order of the Sinking Star', the Ultimate Puzzle Game
seoTitle: Jonathan Blow Details Massive New Puzzle Game
subtitle: Braid creator discusses the launch of Order of the Sinking Star, featuring around 1,500 challenges
excerpt: Order of the Sinking Star launches this Thursday with approximately 1,500 puzzles, according to Braid creator Jonathan Blow.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Jonathan Blow, renowned for developing the acclaimed Braid, opens up about his upcoming title, which he describes as the largest puzzle game ever created.

Titled Order of the Sinking Star, the game is scheduled to launch this Thursday. According to the developer, the experience offers roughly 1,500 different puzzles for players to tackle.

Blow's discussion focuses on the complexity and variety of the proposed challenges, aiming to deliver an extensive journey within the puzzle genre.

With information from BBC News.
